definitions.explanation: A carton made of coated paperboard, used for milk, juice and other drinks. Also the paper dust bag of a vacuum cleaner.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}パック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a carton of milk.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}パック⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Wash paper cartons and put them out for recycling.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{切|き}り{開|ひら}いた→切り開く：05745_kirihiraku⟧{紙|かみ}パック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: At the supermarket entrance there is a box for collecting cartons that have been washed and cut open.

notes:
Made of ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper) + ⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧ (pack). In Japan, milk cartons are commonly rinsed, cut open, dried and taken to collection boxes at supermarkets, where they are recycled into toilet paper and similar products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紙|かみ}パック{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧: juice in a carton
- ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: milk carton (the everyday word for the most common kind)
- {紙|かみ}パック{式|しき}⟦{掃除機|そうじき}→掃除機：04967_soujiki⟧: vacuum cleaner that uses paper dust bags

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧: plastic (PET) bottle
